summary: During the March 13, 2019 bomb-cyclone blizzard, Douglas County Search and Rescue evacuated 54 stranded motorists and 2 dogs from the I-25 corridor between Castle Rock and the Douglas County border. Activated at 12:02 p.m. by the Douglas County Office of Emergency Management, 14 members used snowmobile teams and 4x4 trucks along Greenland Rd, Spruce Mountain, and Upper Lake Gulch Rd; teams cleared at 2:00 a.m. March 14 after ~120 volunteer hours.
location: I-25 corridor, Castle Rock to Douglas County border
notes: DCSAR Belay On Issue #98 (March 2019 newsletter); incident date pinned to Wednesday 2019-03-13 by the dated source. MERGED/INSERTED run 987.
